records.comment: I left the rating as it loaded because I was focused on reporting this: during the first preheat, the oven sparked behind the control panel, released gray smoke, and tripped the kitchen breaker. I stopped using it.
The courier arrived two days late and the carton was scuffed. The oven itself completed two heating cycles with no sparks, smoke, unusual heat, or odor.
Pairing the mobile application took several attempts. The purifier now runs normally, and I observed no smoke, sparking, excess heat, or electrical odor.
